response.summary: The available annual hiring budget is €52,000: €96,000 approved less €44,000 already committed. At the benchmark loaded cost of €48,000 per hire, that funds 1 additional hire and no more.

facts.claim: The approved annual hiring budget is €96,000.
facts.label: Approved annual hiring budget

facts.claim: €44,000 of the hiring budget is already committed.
facts.label: Already committed hiring budget

facts.claim: The available annual hiring budget is €52,000.
facts.label: Available annual hiring budget

facts.claim: The benchmark annual loaded cost per hire is €48,000.
facts.label: Benchmark annual loaded cost per hire

facts.claim: At most 1 additional hire is affordable.
facts.label: Maximum affordable additional hires

concerns: A second hire would exceed the available hiring budget of €52,000 unless the approved figure is raised.
Cash runway of 8 months is measured against a zero-revenue stress case, so it is a floor rather than a forecast.
response.recommendation: Fund at most 1 additional role this period, and cap its loaded annual cost at the €48,000 benchmark. Any second hire needs either a budget increase or evidence of committed new revenue.
missingInformation: The €48,000 loaded cost per hire is a market benchmark and an assumption, not an agreed offer figure.
No per-department cost allocation exists, so the cost impact on a specific team cannot be isolated.
Finance holds no staffing or capacity data, so it cannot say which team should receive a hire.
